hints:
> Key Concept: 0 – 200 m, straight line $\rightarrow$ $\frac{dv}{dx}$ is constant; hence use $a = v\frac{dv}{dx} = v \times constant$

>

> Here v = 10 + 0.2x, so a = 0.2v = 2 + 0.04x: a straight line rising from 2 m/s² at x = 0 to 10 m/s² at x = 200 m; beyond 200 m, v is constant and a = 0.
